note: v11: three scroll chapters. Each chapter is one scroll section on desktop (vh = min-height) and one frameless DOM scene on the stage (public/assets/scenes.js). beats = what happens on the right, in order; the left copy marks its elements with data-beat="n". Beat positions as shares of the chapter's scroll are set in desktop.js (BEATS).
